exams.name: National Board Examination (theoretical)
exams.notes: Completion with scores acceptable to the board is a prerequisite to taking the dental examinations.
exams.quote: Completion of the national board theoretical examination with scores acceptable to the board, as promulgated by rule, is a prerequisite to taking the dental examinations.

exams.name: Missouri Dental Examination (written, oral, or clinical)
exams.notes: Board determines by rule whether written, oral, or clinical or all three. Board sets by rule number of times applicant may fail without additional education.
exams.quote: The board shall determine and specify by rule whether the dental examinations shall be written or oral or clinical or all three, but in any event they shall be in such form and of such content and character as to thoroughly test the qualifications of the applicant to practice dentistry in Missouri.

interval_years.quote: Effective with the licensing period beginning on December 1, 2002, a license shall be renewed every two years.

required.quote: To renew a license, each dentist shall submit satisfactory evidence of completion of fifty hours of continuing education during the two-year period immediately preceding the renewal period.

hours_per_period.quote: completion of fifty hours of continuing education during the two-year period immediately preceding the renewal period

period_years.quote: completion of fifty hours of continuing education during the two-year period immediately preceding the renewal period

available.quote: The board shall grant without examination a certificate of registration and a license to a dentist who has been licensed in another state for at least five consecutive years immediately preceding his applying, if the board is satisfied by proof adduced by the applicant that his qualifications are at least equivalent to the requirements for initial registration as a dentist in Missouri under the provisions of this chapter

requirements.value: Licensed in another state for at least 5 consecutive years immediately preceding application; qualifications at least equivalent to Missouri initial registration requirements; at least 21 years of age and good moral character. Board may require Missouri law exam and/or practical exam if prior licensure was denied, revoked, or suspended for incompetency.

title_protection.quote: Uses or permits to be used for the person's benefit or for the benefit of any other person or other entity the following titles or words in connection with the person's name: "Doctor", "Dentist", "Dr.", "D.D.S.", or "D.M.D.", or any other letters, titles, degrees or descriptive matter which directly or indirectly indicate or imply that the person is willing or able to perform any type of dental service

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices dentistry as defined in section 332.071, or as a dental hygienist as defined in section 332.091, who is not duly registered and currently licensed in Missouri as hereinafter provided is guilty of a class A misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of controlled substance or alcohol to extent that it impairs ability to perform professional duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any controlled substance, as defined in chapter 195, or alcoholic beverage to an extent that such use impairs a person's ability to perform the work of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication of guilt or plea of guilty/nolo contendere for offense reasonably related to profession, involving fraud/dishonesty/violence, or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The person has been finally adjudicated and found guilty, or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, in a criminal prosecution pursuant to the laws of any state or of the United States, for any offense reasonably related to the qualifications, functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation, or bribery in securing a permit or license or permission to take an exam
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing any permit or license issued pursuant to this chapter or in obtaining permission to take any examination given or required pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain fees by fraud, deception, or misrepresentation; billing irregularities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain any fee, charge, tuition or other compensation by fraud, deception or misrepresentation; or increasing charges when a patient utilizes a third-party payment program; or for repeated irregularities in billing a third party for services rendered to a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetency, misconduct, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation, or dishonesty in performance of professional duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetency, misconduct, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation or dishonesty in the performance of, or relating to one's ability to perform, the functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of or assisting any person to violate any provision of the chapter or lawful rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of this chapter, or any lawful rule or regulation adopted pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonation of a permit or license holder, or allowing another to use one's permit, license, or diploma
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonation of any person holding a permit or license or allowing any person to use his or her permit, license or diploma from any school

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action imposed by another state, province, territory, federal agency, or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action against the holder of a license or other right to practice any profession regulated by this chapter imposed by another state, province, territory, federal agency or country upon grounds for which discipline is authorized in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final adjudication of incapacity or disability by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person is finally adjudicated incapacitated or disabled by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting or enabling an unregistered or ineligible person to practice by lack of supervision or other means
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting or enabling any person to practice or offer to practice, by lack of supervision or in any other manner, any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter who is not registered and currently eligible to practice pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuance of a permit or license based upon a material mistake of fact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Issuance of a permit or license based upon a material mistake of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to display a valid certificate, permit, or license as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to display a valid certificate, permit or license if so required by this chapter or by any rule promulgated hereunder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any professional trust or confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any professional trust or confidence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of any advertisement or solicitation that is false, misleading, or deceptive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any advertisement or solicitation that is false, misleading or deceptive to the general public or persons to whom the advertisement or solicitation is primarily directed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of drug laws or rules of this state, any other state, or the federal government
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the drug laws or rules and regulations of this state, any other state or the federal government

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to properly guard against contagious, infectious, or communicable diseases or their spread
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal to properly guard against contagious, infectious or communicable diseases or the spread thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain office, laboratory, equipment, and instruments in a safe and sanitary condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to maintain his or her office or offices, laboratory, equipment and instruments in a safe and sanitary condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting, tendering, or paying rebates or splitting fees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting, tendering or paying rebates to or splitting fees with any other person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering or permitting nitrous oxide gas to oneself or another except as an adjunctive measure to patient management
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, or causing or permitting to be administered, nitrous oxide gas in any amount to himself or herself, or to another unless as an adjunctive measure to patient management

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety by reason of professional incompetency, illness, drunkenness, excessive use of drugs, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice as a dentist, specialist or hygienist with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reasons of professional incompetency, or because of illness, drunkenness, excessive use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Any dental office where deep sedation or general anesthesia or conscious sedation agents are administered shall possess a site certificate issued by the board and comply with the board's minimum standard for site certificates.

definition_quote.value: A person or other entity "practices dentistry" within the meaning of this chapter who: (1) Undertakes to do or perform dental work or dental services or dental operations or oral surgery, by any means or methods, including the use of lasers, gratuitously or for a salary or fee or other reward...
definition_quote.quote: A person or other entity "practices dentistry" within the meaning of this chapter who: (1) Undertakes to do or perform dental work or dental services or dental operations or oral surgery, by any means or methods, including the use of lasers, gratuitously or for a salary or fee or other reward, paid directly or indirectly to the person or to any other person or entity;

methods_authorized.quote: Undertakes to do or perform dental work or dental services or dental operations or oral surgery, by any means or methods, including the use of lasers

drug_authority.value: A licensed dentist may prescribe, possess, administer, dispense, or distribute drugs and controlled substances necessary or proper in the practice of dentistry, subject to federal and state narcotic and controlled substance laws, including required DEA and state registration. Long-acting opioids may not be used for acute pain without documented justification; doses exceeding 50 MME/day for acute pain require documentation.
drug_authority.quote: Any duly registered and currently licensed dentist in Missouri may write, and any pharmacist in Missouri who is currently licensed under the provisions of chapter 338 and any amendments thereto, may fill any prescription of a duly registered and currently licensed dentist in Missouri for any drug necessary or proper in the practice of dentistry

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: All duly registered and currently licensed dentists in Missouri who prescribe and administer deep sedation or general anesthesia agents in the course of providing dental services shall possess a deep sedation or general anesthesia permit issued by the board. All duly registered and currently licensed dentists in Missouri who prescribe and administer conscious sedation agents in the course of providing dental services shall possess a conscious sedation permit issued by the board.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: Any dental office where deep sedation or general anesthesia or conscious sedation agents are administered shall possess a site certificate issued by the board and comply with the board's minimum standard for site certificates.

specialist_license_available.quote: The board shall upon application issue a specialist's license to any currently licensed dentist in Missouri who has been certified in any specialty by an examining board recognized by the American Dental Association.

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: Any announcement containing any of the terms denoting recognized specialties, or other descriptive terms carrying the same meaning, unless the announcement clearly designates by list each dentist not licensed as a specialist in Missouri who is sponsoring or named in the announcement, or employed by the entity sponsoring the announcement, after the following clearly legible or audible statement: "Notice: the following dentist(s) in this practice is (are) not licensed in Missouri as specialists in the advertised dental specialty(s) of _________ ".

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: a dental hygienist shall only practice under the supervision of a dentist who is duly registered and currently licensed in Missouri, except as provided in subsection 2 of this section.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A duly registered and currently licensed dental hygienist who has been in practice at least three years and who is practicing in a public health setting may provide fluoride treatments, teeth cleaning and sealants, if appropriate, to children who are eligible for medical assistance, pursuant to chapter 208, without the supervision of a dentist.

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Long-acting or extended-release opioids shall not be used for the treatment of acute pain. If in the professional judgment of the dentist, a long-acting or extended-release opioid is necessary to treat the patient, the dentist shall document and explain in the patient's dental record the reason for the necessity for the long-acting or extended-release opioid.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Constructs, supplies, reproduces or repairs any prosthetic denture, bridge, artificial restoration, appliance or other structure to be used or worn as a substitute for natural teeth, except when one, not a registered and licensed dentist, does so pursuant to a written uniform laboratory work order, in the form prescribed by the board, of a dentist registered and currently licensed in Missouri

teledentistry_authorized.quote: The rendering of any written or otherwise documented dental opinion concerning the diagnosis or treatment of a patient within this state by a dentist located outside this state as a result of transmission of individual patient data by electronic, telephonic, or other means from within this state or any other state to such dentist or dentist's agent

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: "Expanded-functions dental assistant", any dental assistant who has passed a basic dental assisting skills mastery examination or a certified dental assistant, either of whom has successfully completed a board-approved expanded-functions course, passed a competency examination, and has obtained a permit authorizing them to perform expanded-functions duties from the Missouri dental board;

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: each dentist shall submit satisfactory evidence of current certification in the American Heart Association's Basic Life Support (BLS), Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS), or certification equivalent to BLS or ACLS

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: a duly registered and currently licensed dental hygienist may only practice as a dental hygienist so long as the dental hygienist is employed by a dentist who is duly registered and currently licensed in Missouri, or as an employee of such other person or entity approved by the board in accordance with rules promulgated by the board.
